title: Finite affine algebra models detecting flatness in a scheme inverse system
statement: Let I be a directed preorder with chosen i₀, D : Iᵒᵖ → Scheme an inverse system with affine transition maps, and (c,hc) a limit cone [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Let f₀ : X₀ → Y₀ be a morphism over D(i₀) [def-pc-fibre-product], with X₀ quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and f₀ locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Write J = {i | i₀ ≤ i}, j₀ = (i₀, refl). There exist n ≥ 0, ring diagrams F_b : J → CommRing for b ∈ Fin n, commutative F_b(j₀)-algebras B_b,C_b, and algebra maps φ_b : B_b → C_b of finite presentation such that: (1) the pullback of f₀ to c.pt is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] if and only if every map id ⊗ φ_b over colimit F_b [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]; (2) for each j ∈ J the pullback of f₀ to D(j) is flat if and only if every map id ⊗ φ_b over F_b(j) is flat. The algebra structure on colimit F_b is induced by the canonical coprojection at j₀; that on F_b(j) is induced by the transition map F_b(j₀ → j). No flatness hypothesis and no eventual-flatness conclusion occur in this statement.

proof.text: Choose affine triples W,V,U around each source point using Mathlib exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset. Compactness gives a finite subcover, reindexed by Fin n using Fintype.equivFin. The empty source gives the empty family automatically.

For each selected W, apply AlgebraicGeometry.exists_affineOpen_directedRingSystem to obtain F, the compatible initial-stage spectrum isomorphism e0, the stage isomorphisms hi, and the limiting isomorphism eL with its canonical colimit coprojection compatibility.

Apply AlgebraicGeometry.exists_affineChart_tensorComparison to each U,V,W and e0. Package its rings and algebra structures as CommAlgCat objects, with the finitely presented map phi. At the limit and each stage, this theorem supplies an arrow isomorphism from the restricted chart map to Spec(id tensor phi).

The inverse images of the selected U cover every base-changed source by Scheme.Hom.iSup_preimage_eq_top. IsZariskiLocalAtSource.iff_of_iSup_eq_top detects Flat on that cover. Cancel the open inclusion of the target chart with MorphismProperty.postcomp_iff (W := Flat) (W' := IsOpenImmersion), transport across the arrow isomorphism, and use Flat.SpecMap_iff. forall_congr' combines the chart equivalences. These operations prove both displayed equivalences without any flatness descent theorem.

theorem exists_finite_affine_flat_models
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (i₀ : I)
    (X₀ Y₀ : Over (D.obj (op i₀))) (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀)
    [CompactSpace X₀.left] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f₀.left] :
    let J := {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}
    let j₀ : J := ⟨i₀, le_rfl⟩
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (F : Fin n → J ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
      (B C : (b : Fin n) → CommAlgCat.{u} (F b |>.obj j₀))
      (φ : (b : Fin n) → B b ⟶ C b),
      (∀ b, (φ b).hom.toRingHom.FinitePresentation) ∧
      (Flat (((Over.pullback (c.π.app (op i₀))).map f₀).left) ↔
        ∀ b,
          letI := (colimit.ι (F b) j₀).hom.toAlgebra
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map
            (R := ((F b).obj j₀ : Type u))
            (S := (colimit (F b) : CommRingCat.{u}))
            (A := (colimit (F b) : CommRingCat.{u})) (B := B b)
            (C := (colimit (F b) : CommRingCat.{u})) (D := C b)
            (Algebra.ofId (colimit (F b) : CommRingCat.{u})
              (colimit (F b) : CommRingCat.{u})) (φ b).hom).toRingHom.Flat) ∧
      (∀ j : J,
        Flat (((Over.pullback (D.map (homOfLE j.property).op)).map f₀).left) ↔
          ∀ b,
            letI := ((F b).map (homOfLE (show j₀ ≤ j from j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.map
              (R := ((F b).obj j₀ : Type u)) (S := ((F b).obj j : Type u))
              (A := ((F b).obj j : Type u)) (B := B b)
              (C := ((F b).obj j : Type u)) (D := C b)
              (Algebra.ofId ((F b).obj j) ((F b).obj j)) (φ b).hom).toRingHom.Flat)
